resolution.question: The two founders of the Tidepool app have been at odds over strategy since spring. Will they announce a buyout of one side to their twelve employees within the next three months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, there is a persistent record (e.g., meeting minutes, official email, or public announcement) that a buyout of one founder by the other has been announced to the employees. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
